newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 17.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi fortnightly T-Bill rate drops to 17.15 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped to 17.15 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 17.34 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Wednesday.
Applications for 137.13 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 137.08 million kwacha at the average price of 96.01 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped to 17.93 percent from 18.46 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 110.1 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 107.10 million kwacha at the average price of 91.52 kwacha percent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate dropped to 18.43 percent from 18.72 four weeks ago. Applications for 68.90 million kwacha of bills on offer were also fully subscribed at the average price of 86.49 kwacha percent.
